::: {#exm-proposal-distribution}
#### A Gaussian random-walk proposal

For a scalar parameter $\pi$,
the proposal $\pi^* \mid \pi \sim \ndist{\pi, 0.05^2}$
draws a candidate within about $\pm 0.1$ of the current value $\pi$.
It is [symmetric](#def-symmetric-proposal): $q(\pi^* \mid \pi) = q(\pi \mid \pi^*)$,
because the Gaussian density depends on $\pi^* - \pi$ only through its square.
:::
